t_advice_summary_textbox.text: to focus on clicking in the 1.5 second time. There is no way of securing more points following a pattern based on colour or height of gnomes

vb_textbox.text: The pairs shown are always the same so you only has to remember which gnome earned you more not how many you find. The first round was very consistent but the next 3 changes which one earned you more. The pink earned the most in the first round. The blue and red ones swapped but overall the red earned the most to start. The tall purple earned more than the small orange to start. Ensure you always pick and answer and don't miss out on points.
